title.narrative: Ending Child Labour in Supply Chains

description.narrative: This action aims at reducing child labour in key sectors and countries in sub-Saharan Africa, Latin America, Caribbean and South-East Asia where child labour is persistent and prevalent, and for which trade with the EU is significant countries. The action will review research and gather evidence on the ground to select a limited number of key global value chains linked to EU trade and suggests key recommendations for pilot interventions in identified countries. The action will support activities to address the knowledge gaps on the root causes of child labour. The action will also support global initiatives and partnerships aiming to accelerate the eradication of child labour, it will reinforce advocacy in international fora and business networks through data sharing and technical expertise.
